tips.text: Poke with Mortal Steel on enemies or minions to build stacks, then use the third cast to dash in and knock them up when you want to trade.
Hit an enemy champion with Spirit Cleave in a trade; the shield is bigger for each champion it hits, and it also clears minion waves.
Start a fight with Soul Unbound, attack inside spirit form, then recast to snap back and deal the stored damage. Use it to escape too.
Do not recall or teleport during Soul Unbound; both are disabled until the spirit form ends.
Aim Fate Sealed so it catches several enemies in a line. It blinks you behind the last champion hit and pulls them to you.
Keep your Mortal Steel stacks up before a fight. They fade after a short time, so a hit on an enemy refreshes them.
Do not save Mortal Steel's dash when you are rooted; it can't be cast at two stacks while rooted.
Poke with Mortal Steel on the enemy or their minions to build stacks, then use the third cast to dash in and knock them up for a short trade.
Use Spirit Cleave when it will hit a champion, since the shield grows when you hit one. Hitting several champions makes it bigger still.
Open a trade with Soul Unbound, attack while in spirit form, then recast it to snap back to your body and deal the stored damage.
Don't linger in spirit form with Soul Unbound when the enemy can hit you. Your body can't be targeted, but you can still be hurt.
Cast Fate Sealed so it catches several enemies. You blink behind the last champion hit and pull them to you, so check where that leaves you.
Save Mortal Steel's third cast for when you are not rooted, because you can't cast it while rooted.
Step sideways out of The Darkin Blade; the hit zones are telegraphed and the edge is the dangerous part.
When Infernal Chains lands, move toward Aatrox or to the side to leave the area before it pulls you back.
Use Mortal Steel on minions or Aatrox to build stacks, then dash through with the knock up on your third cast.
Spirit Cleave gives you a shield when it hits. Use it when you trade so Aatrox's damage is reduced.
Aatrox heals more with World Ender up. Stay away from him then, and do not let him get a takedown.
Stack two hits with Mortal Steel, then dash in to knock Akali up when she spends her energy.
Use Spirit Cleave when you trade with Akali. The shield soaks her poke and the damage is based on her max Health.
Akali's Five Point Strike is strongest at long range, so step in close and trade when her energy is low.
Back off at low Health when Akali has Perfect Execution ready. It hits harder the lower you are.
When Akali hides in Twilight Shroud, do not chase blindly. Use Spirit Cleave on the smoke to reveal her.
Land Mortal Steel twice, then use the third cast to dash in and knock Ambessa up.
Stay out of Lacerate range when it is ready; it slows you hard, and she can dash in and spin a second time.
Cast Spirit Cleave when you trade, not before. It gives you a shield and hits harder against her health.
Use Soul Unbound to hit her, then step back. When it ends, you snap back to your body and repeat part of the damage you dealt.
Play safer when Public Execution is ready, since she can blink to the farthest champion in a line and suppress them.
Sidestep Flash Frost; it is slow and wide but easy to read. Getting hit means a slow and a possible stun.
Use Soul Unbound to dodge Flash Frost and close the gap. Attack her during it so the damage repeats.
Hit minions with Mortal Steel to build stacks, then dash through her for the knock up once Crystallize is on cooldown.
Use Spirit Cleave when you trade with her; the shield soaks her Frostbite.
Kill her egg after she dies. Fate Sealed pulls her in and stuns her, so the burst can finish her.
Walk up and trade with Mortal Steel when The Weirding is on cooldown; Aurora then has little to slow you with or hop away from.
Sidestep the Twofold Hex bolt; it is a straight line, and getting hit lets her recall it for more damage.
Land Spirit Cleave when you trade; it hits for a share of her max Health and shields you.
Use Soul Unbound to start a trade, then fight in spirit form; it repeats part of the damage you deal when you snap back.
At level 6, Fate Sealed can catch her after she hops away with Across the Veil; it stuns and pulls her to you.
Chilling Scream charges can't be interrupted, so don't bother trying. Step out of its direction and fight when it is over.
Stay away from walls when Briar charges Chilling Scream. A full charge knocks you back into the wall and stuns you.
Use Spirit Cleave when Briar arrives in Blood Frenzy; you get a shield and hit her for damage based on max health.
Briar's Head Rush stuns you, so keep Soul Unbound ready. When she commits, you can dash away.
Stay out of Camille's Hookshot range and keep Mortal Steel ready; its knock up can punish her dash in.
Cast Spirit Cleave when you trade with Camille; the shield cushions her hits and it hurts her based on her max health.
Keep your distance when Camille's Tactical Sweep is ready; being slowed lets her heal off you and close in.
Do not fight inside The Hextech Ultimatum zone without a plan; recasting Soul Unbound ends it.
Use Soul Unbound to trade and then snap back; the stored damage hits as true damage, so camp near Camille's range without overstaying.
Watch the ground marking from Rupture and sidestep it, or dash out before it lands. If it hits you, you are knocked up and slowed.
Stay out of the cone of Feral Scream when you go in; being silenced cuts off your dash and Spirit Cleave.
Use Soul Unbound to trade, then snap back out of range before Cho'Gath can answer with Rupture.
Hit Cho'Gath's minions and pressure him before he stacks Feast. Once he is huge, he takes your hits and eats you.
Stay out of Apprehend's range. When it is on cooldown, poke Darius freely.
Land Mortal Steel twice, then cast it again for the dash. It knocks Darius up so you can step out of his range.
Cast Spirit Cleave when you trade. The shield absorbs part of Darius's damage.
Don't let Darius reach many Hemorrhage stacks. Back off once he has stacked you, since Noxian Guillotine hits harder with each stack.
Use Soul Unbound to trade and get away. Hit Darius while in spirit form and the stored damage hits him when you snap back.
Do not rely on Fate Sealed to lock Mundo down; Goes Where He Pleases resists the first stun or knock up. Wait until it is spent.
Sidestep Infected Bonesaw. It is a narrow line shot that stops at the first enemy, so keep minions between you and Mundo.
Step away or stay out of range while Heart Zapper charges. Fight when it is on cooldown.
Use Spirit Cleave on Mundo for the shield. His health scales its damage, but he heals it back, so do not stay in a long fight.
Use Soul Unbound to trade with Mundo and walk away. Fight him in short bursts instead of one long brawl.
Do not throw Mortal Steel at two stacks or Fate Sealed into Fiora when Riposte is ready; she parries and stuns you.
Bait Riposte with a cheap Mortal Steel, then fight while it is on cooldown.
Use Spirit Cleave when she walks in; the shield helps you win the trade.
Watch where her Vital appears; that shows where Fiora will try to Lunge from, so be ready to punish her.
Trade with Soul Unbound active so the stored damage hits her when you snap back.
Gangplank's Remove Scurvy clears your knock up and stun, so save Fate Sealed until it is on cooldown.
Stay out of Powder Keg blast areas; the slow lets Gangplank hit you again. Hit his kegs with Mortal Steel to defuse them.
Use Spirit Cleave on Gangplank when you trade; the shield is bigger when it hits a champion.
Watch for Gangplank's level 6; Cannon Barrage can hit you from anywhere on the map, so don't stay low and alone.
Keep Mortal Steel going on Garen from long range to build stacks, then knock him up with the third cast when you want to trade.
Hit Garen with Spirit Cleave to gain a shield, which helps you win short trades.
Do not let Garen get a Decisive Strike hit on you; it silences you and shuts off your abilities.
Stay away from Garen when you are low, because Demacian Justice can finish you quickly.
Use Soul Unbound to hit Garen and move quickly away from his Judgment.
Dodge Boomerang Throw if you can. Its slow ruins your approach, and Gnar wants to throw it again fast.
Build your Mortal Steel stacks on minions, then dash through Gnar with the third cast to knock him up and close the gap.
Fight Gnar while he is tired after leaving Mega form, because he cannot gain Rage then.
Avoid fighting Gnar near walls once his Rage is full, since GNAR! stuns you if it throws you into one.
Use Spirit Cleave to hit Gnar and gain a shield. It deals extra damage to him, since it scales with his max health.
Use Soul Unbound to dash through Gnar's reach and attack him. Your body stays behind, and the damage you stored hits him when you snap back.
Stay out of range of Gragas's Body Slam; if he stuns you, his follow-up hits hard.
Step away from a Barrel Roll that is sitting in lane; it hurts more and slows more the longer it waits.
Use Spirit Cleave to trade and gain a shield when Gragas walks up; it also hurts more against his big health.
Use Soul Unbound to run out of danger or escape after a trade; Gragas has a hard time catching you.
Do not use Fate Sealed near Gragas's tower or into his Explosive Cask; being knocked away ruins your engage.
Don't chase Gwen while she stands in Hallowed Mist; she can't be targeted from outside it. Wait for the mist to end or lure her out before you commit.
Hold Fate Sealed until the mist is gone. It stuns Gwen and pulls her toward you, which makes it a strong finisher once she has no way to dodge.
Trade right after Gwen uses Skip 'n Slash. Her empowered attacks are the dangerous part, so step back out of her longer reach when they run out.
Use Spirit Cleave to hit Gwen and gain a shield before she lands Snip Snip!
Land two Mortal Steel hits, then dash through Gwen for a knock up. Don't give her free attacks, since stacks make Snip Snip!
Dodge the grenade, because CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade stuns at its center and leaves you open to turrets. Wait for it to be used before you dive.
Kill all of Heimerdinger's turrets together with minions around, using Spirit Cleave to hit turrets and him at once. Don't fight them one at a time.
Build up two Mortal Steel stacks on minions, then use the third cast to knock him up and close the gap.
Be careful with Soul Unbound in range of his turrets, since he can punish you while you are away from your body. Use it to dodge Hextech Micro-Rockets.
Look to go in with Fate Sealed once UPGRADE!!! is on cooldown. He has fewer ways out then.
Stay out of Illaoi's Tentacles; fighting away from walls and her Tentacles takes away much of her power.
Dodge Tentacle Smash by stepping sideways while it winds up, then hit her with Mortal Steel.
Use Soul Unbound to dash away from Illaoi when her Test of Spirit pulls out your spirit; fight back and hit her to shorten it.
Kill Tentacles when you can; with fewer of them Illaoi is much weaker.
Use Spirit Cleave when Illaoi leaps at you; its shield softens the trade.
Don't spend Fate Sealed or other big spells on Irelia's Defiant Dance; wait until she releases it.
Fight Irelia away from minion waves; they give her Bladesurge dashes to chase you.
Use Spirit Cleave when Irelia dashes in; the shield helps you survive the trade.
Take on Irelia when her Ionian Fervor stacks have run out; she hits much weaker then.
Wait out Counter Strike before you attack Jax. His dodge stops your attacks, and the stun follows when it ends.
Poke him with Mortal Steel and trade in short bursts. Do not stand and trade, because Jax's attack speed grows the longer he keeps hitting.
Use Spirit Cleave when you trade; the shield blunts his damage, and it grows if more than one champion is hit.
Use Soul Unbound to fight in spirit form. Your hits are stored and dealt again as true damage when you snap back.
Jayce wins at long range, so close the gap with Mortal Steel on minions to build stacks, then dash onto him.
Use Spirit Cleave when you trade; the shield helps you survive his burst.
Use Soul Unbound to step in, hit him, and return; your body stays safe while you deal the stored damage.
When Jayce has Thundering Blow ready, do not rush him; it knocks you back and costs your stacks' timing.
Dodge Shock Blast by sidestepping; it stops at the first enemy, so keep a minion in line.
Stay out of Ntofo Strikes range when it has two stacks; the shockwave stuns you and pulls you in, so keep your distance until it has been used.
Use Spirit Cleave when you want a shield for a trade. It hits harder against a tanky enemy who has lots of health.
Trade with Mortal Steel, and use the knock up on your third cast to start a fight, not just to poke.
Be careful when K'Sante charges Path Maker. Step out of its line, because anyone it hits is stunned.
When K'Sante goes All Out, he loses a lot of health and resistances. Fight him then and kill him fast.
Fight Kayle hard before level 6, while she is stuck in melee and weak. Put her behind early.
Hit Kayle with Mortal Steel twice, then dash in with the third to knock her up and close the gap.
Use Fate Sealed to stun and pull Kayle to you. Wait until she has spent Divine Judgment, or she can become invulnerable.
Cast Spirit Cleave when you trade with Kayle; the shield helps you survive her poke.
Sidestep Radiant Blast; it stops on the first enemy it hits, and you do not want to be slowed.
Dodge Thundering Shuriken sideways. Kennen needs three Marks of the Storm to stun you, so try not to take the first two.
Hit Kennen when he gets careless with Lightning Rush. He is fragile, and you can punish him with Mortal Steel.
Use Spirit Cleave when you trade. The shield absorbs some of Kennen's damage.
Use Soul Unbound to hit Kennen, then pull back to your body. You deal extra damage when it ends.
Land Mortal Steel twice, then the third cast dashes and knocks Kled up. Use it to start or finish a trade.
Keep your distance from Kled when his Bear Trap on a Rope is ready. If it hooks you, move away quickly.
Use Spirit Cleave when you trade with Kled. It hits for a share of his max health, and Kled has a lot of health.
Respect Kled when Violent Tendencies is ready, because his fast hits end in a heavy blow. Back off until it is on cooldown.
Stay out of Malphite's Unstoppable Force range when your Fate Sealed is down. Standing near your allies helps.
Break his Granite Shield with quick hits before you commit; he is much tankier while it is up.
Use Spirit Cleave to shield yourself when you trade, since Malphite's Seismic Shard and Ground Slam hurt a lot.
Don't fight inside Malphite's Ground Slam range with your attacks; it lowers your Attack Speed and your damage.
Stay out of Mordekaiser's aura range. Darkness Rise hurts more the longer you fight beside him, so trade in short bursts.
Watch for Death's Grasp. Sidestep it or use Soul Unbound to get away; it pulls you toward him.
Hold Mortal Steel's third cast to dash out of Mordekaiser's reach after a trade.
Use Spirit Cleave to trade into Mordekaiser's lone hits. Its shield helps you absorb his damage.
Be ready when Mordekaiser reaches level 6. Realm of Death takes you away from your team, so save Soul Unbound or Fate Sealed to escape.
Hit Mortal Steel on minions or Naafiri twice, and the third cast dashes in and knocks her up. Save that third cast for when she is in range.
Use Spirit Cleave when you trade. It hits her for a share of her max health and gives you a shield, bigger if it hits her.
Start a trade with Soul Unbound, hit her while in spirit form, then recall it so the stored damage lands on her.
At level 6, use Fate Sealed to finish her off or to escape; it leaves her stunned and pulls her toward you.
Stay out of Wither range when you can. Once you are slowed and your Attack Speed drops, Yone loses most of his fighting power.
Trade with Mortal Steel while Nasus walks up to last-hit. Hit him twice and the third cast dashes and knocks him up.
Use Soul Unbound while trading. Hit Nasus in spirit form, then snap back to your body to repeat part of that damage.
Fight Nasus early, before Siphoning Strike has made him hit hard. Do not fight him while Fury of the Sands is active.
Spirit Cleave gives you a shield when it hits Nasus. Use it in a trade to absorb some of his hits.
Walk out of the line of Undertow's axe and don't stand where it lands. If Olaf can't grab it, his harassment is much weaker.
Save Fate Sealed until Ragnarok has ended. Olaf is immune to its knock up and stun while it is active.
Use Soul Unbound when you trade. Hit Olaf in spirit form and you take him for extra true damage when you snap back.
Hit Olaf with Spirit Cleave. It deals damage based on his max health and gives you a shield for the trade.
Don't chase a low-health Olaf without a plan. He becomes more dangerous the lower he is, so use your disables to finish him.
Stay away from walls when Ornn is near. Without a wall, Searing Charge cannot knock you up.
Sidestep Volcanic Rupture. It stops at the first champion it hits, and the pillar it leaves can block your dash.
Trade with Mortal Steel and use Spirit Cleave for a shield. It also deals extra damage to a tanky Ornn, since it scales with his max Health.
Don't get hit by Bellows Breath before Ornn's follow-up. Brittle makes any stun on you last longer.
Use Soul Unbound to hit Ornn from spirit form. The damage you stored hits him when you snap back.
Stay out of Pantheon's Shield Vault range and don't be caught alone. It stuns you, and his empowered hits follow.
Don't attack into Aegis Assault from the front, because he can't be hurt from that side. Wait it out or hit him from behind.
Use Spirit Cleave to shield yourself in trades, and Mortal Steel to poke him back when he walks in.
Watch your health. A thrown Comet Spear deals far more damage to you when you are low.
Grand Starfall gives a warning before he lands, so move out of the area.
Walk through Quinn's Blinding Assault line with care. Hold Mortal Steel for after she commits, because she has to aim it.
Land two Mortal Steel hits on Quinn, then dash in with the third to knock her up. Quinn's Vault gets her out afterward, so follow up quickly.
Use Spirit Cleave when Quinn is close. It hits her and gives you a shield for the trade.
Move away once Quinn marks you with Harrier, because her next attack hits hard. Do not stand still for it.
Trade with Soul Unbound active. Your hits are stored and repeated as extra damage when you snap back.
Keep your distance from Renekton when his Fury is high. Empowered Ruthless Predator stuns for a long time.
Poke with Mortal Steel while the enemy farms; each hit builds toward the knock up.
Use Soul Unbound to trade, then pull back; it repeats part of your damage when it ends.
Do not walk into Renekton right after he uses Slice and Dice; he can dash back out.
Cast Spirit Cleave when you trade for its shield, but not into an empowered Ruthless Predator, which destroys shields.
Keep poking Riven with Mortal Steel from long range. She must dash in to answer it.
Stay a little outside Ki Burst's short range. Being stunned by it is how Riven wins trades against you.
Use Spirit Cleave when Riven dashes in; you get a shield if it hits her.
Use Soul Unbound to trade, then fall back to your body. Your attacks while in spirit form are repeated on Riven when it ends.
Riven's Broken Wings third cast knocks you up. Do not stand still near her once she has used the first two.
Use Fate Sealed when Riven has spent her dashes and Valor. Her escape is short-ranged.
Rumble's Heat bar shows when he overheats. Go in and trade while he can't cast spells.
Stay out of Flamespitter's cone, since it hurts more the more Health you have. Step to the side rather than walking straight at him.
Sidestep Electro Harpoon. A second hit slows you more and cuts your Magic Resist, so never take both.
Use Fate Sealed to dive Rumble when he is low or out of Heat. Don't stay in The Equalizer's fire, because the burning trail slows and burns you.
Use Spirit Cleave on Rumble to gain a shield, then fight while it holds.
Stay out of Facebreaker range when Sett has enemies on both sides of him, such as a wave and you. A stun there leaves you stunned and open to his punches.
Use Spirit Cleave when you trade. It hits for a share of his max Health and gives you a shield, so you win the short fight.
Use Soul Unbound to start a trade, hit him while in spirit form, then recall the dash. Part of your damage repeats on him when you snap back.
Land Mortal Steel twice, then cast it a third time to dash and knock him up. Use that dash to get out of his reach too.
Do not trade into Sett after he has taken a lot of damage. Haymaker turns that damage into a big shield and a heavy punch.
Dodge Shadow Dash. If Shen misses it, step in and trade while it is on cooldown.
Do not fight inside Spirit's Refuge; it blocks your basic attacks. Wait for it to end before you attack.
Use Soul Unbound to dash out of Shen's range if you are in a bad spot. Its recast brings you back to your body.
After level 6, watch for Shen's Stand United, which can bring him to a fight anywhere on the map.
Don't chase Singed through his Poison Trail; he can run away and the trail keeps hurting you.
Walk out of Mega Adhesive's area if you can, and don't stand next to it when Singed is close, because Fling into it roots you.
Use Spirit Cleave when you trade; its shield absorbs some of Singed's poison damage while you hit him.
Hit Singed twice with Mortal Steel to dash and knock him up, but only when he is not about to Fling you.
Sion's Decimating Smash is slow to charge and its aim is shown on the ground. Step out of the line before he releases it.
Use Mortal Steel on Sion's minions to build stacks. The third cast dashes and knocks him up, so use it to close the gap on him.
Hit Sion with Spirit Cleave when you trade. It deals extra damage to his high Health and gives you a shield.
Don't kill Sion when he's low in a long fight. Glory in Death brings him back with fast attacks, so back off until it fades.
Use Soul Unbound to dodge Sion's Decimating Smash or to attack and retreat. You snap back to your body at the end.
Dodge Tongue Lash by walking sideways. It stops at the first unit it hits, so keep minions between you and Tahm Kench.
Count Tahm Kench's hits on you. Once he has three stacks, back off, because Tongue Lash then stuns you.
Trade when Tahm Kench uses the shield from Thick Skin. He gives up healing and stores no new grey health for a while.
Abyssal Dive has a long channel before it lands. Dash away from the marked spot, or use Mortal Steel's dash to leave.
Use Spirit Cleave when you trade for a shield. Tahm Kench has lots of health, so it hits him hard.
Walk through the lane carefully; Teemo's Noxious Trap mushrooms are hidden and slow you. Watch brush and your path before stepping in.
Teemo's Blinding Dart makes your attacks miss, so trade with abilities like Spirit Cleave while you are blinded.
Chain two Mortal Steel hits and dash onto Teemo; the knock up gives you free hits on a fragile target.
Use Fate Sealed at level 6 to catch Teemo when he strays forward; he cannot easily escape it.
Do not back out after Teemo hits you with Toxic Shot; the poison keeps ticking, so commit or stay out of range.
Land Mortal Steel twice, then the third cast knocks Tryndamere up; use it to start your trade.
Do not walk away from Tryndamere with your back to him after Mocking Shout; you get slowed.
Do not burst him to low health and relax; Undying Rage keeps him alive. Wait it out before you go in again.
Use Spirit Cleave to shield yourself while trading; it hits harder on a champion.
Step out of the way of Corrosive Charge; it lands after a short delay. Getting hit leaves you slowed.
Don't walk up to Urgot with Disdain ready. It stuns the first champion it hits and flings them behind him.
Use Spirit Cleave when Urgot is in range; it hits him for a share of his max health and gives you a shield.
Stay out of his Purge range when you can; it locks onto a champion Urgot's abilities hit. Fight at the edge of range instead.
Stay above the low-health threshold once Fear Beyond Death hits you. Below it, Urgot can pull you in and execute you.
Close the gap on Varus by hitting minions with Mortal Steel to build stacks. The third cast dashes and knocks him up.
Dodge Piercing Arrow by moving sideways when he starts charging. It is a thin line shot, and it slows him while he charges.
Use Soul Unbound to dash onto Varus and trade. The damage you deal in spirit form repeats on him when you snap back.
Don't walk into Hail of Arrows; it slows you and cuts your healing. Wait for it to fade before you go in.
Respect Chain of Corruption; being rooted by it can get you killed. Stay out of its long range when it is ready.
Dash onto Vayne with Mortal Steel once you have two stacks; the dash crosses terrain and knocks her up.
Stay away from walls when Vayne has Condemn ready, or you get stunned.
Use Spirit Cleave when you step in to trade; the shield helps you survive her attacks.
Vayne is fragile, so look to kill her with Fate Sealed at level 6 once she has spent Tumble.
Dodge Vladimir's Transfusion by keeping distance; its range is long, so trade right after he uses it.
Wait out Sanguine Pool before you go in with Fate Sealed; he can't be targeted, and you'd land in the damage pool.
Use Spirit Cleave when you trade; its damage scales on max Health, which hurts a tanky Vladimir, and the shield helps you survive.
Use Mortal Steel to build stacks on minions or him, then knock him up with the third cast.
Avoid fighting while Hemoplague is on you; Vladimir heals when it bursts.
Keep Mortal Steel going on Volibear and the minions to build your two stacks. The third cast dashes through him and knocks him up.
Back off when Volibear has Thundering Smash active. Its stun leaves you open to a long trade.
Use Spirit Cleave in a trade. The shield absorbs some of his damage, and it grows if you hit a champion.
Use Soul Unbound to hit him with a few attacks, then recast to detonate the stored damage. Use it to escape too, since your body stays behind.
Step out of the lightning from Sky Splitter after it is cast. It slows you if it lands.
Use Mortal Steel on minions to build stacks, then dash in with the third cast to knock Xin Zhao up.
Do not fight Xin Zhao when he has the full Three Talon Strike combo ready. Trade right after he uses it.
Spirit Cleave gives you a shield when it hits. Use it when you trade so Xin Zhao's attacks do less.
Hit Xin Zhao in spirit form with Soul Unbound, then snap back and repeat part of that damage.
Do not stand close to Xin Zhao at level 6. Crescent Guard hits hard and knocks you back unless you are Challenged.
Wind Becomes Lightning can be sidestepped. Do not stay in a straight line from Xin Zhao, or you get slowed.
Hold Mortal Steel's third cast until Yasuo's Wind Wall is gone; the wall destroys the whirlwind.
Spirit Cleave passes through Wind Wall, so use it to trade and shield when Yasuo walls.
Watch Yasuo's second Steel Tempest; his whirlwind knocks you up, so sidestep it.
Wait out Yasuo's shield from Way of the Wanderer before you trade; it lasts only a short time.
Break Dark Procession by attacking it, or dash out with Mortal Steel once it has two stacks. The dash can cross terrain.
Kill Mist Walkers with a basic attack before you fight Yorick. They die to one attack or one single-target spell.
Use Spirit Cleave when Yorick and his Mist Walkers are in front of you. It hits them all and gives a bigger shield for each champion hit.
Trade with Soul Unbound active. Your hits are stored and dealt again when you snap back to your body.
Dodge sideways when Zaahen casts Dreaded Return; getting pulled and stunned lets him follow up with a full combo.
Zaahen's Dreaded Return is a projectile, so keep minions between you and him when he is in range.
Trade with Mortal Steel and use Spirit Cleave when he walks up to hit you; the shield softens his return hits.
Do not stay in long fights, because every hit Zaahen lands on you makes him stronger. Hit him, then back out before he is full.
If Zaahen fills up and would die, he revives. Use Fate Sealed only when it finishes him, or when his revive has already been used.
Zaahen is immune to crowd control while casting Grim Deliverance, so do not use Fate Sealed on him then.
Walk around Ahri's Charm by staying behind minions, since it stops at the first enemy it hits. Dash through the orb's lane sideways.
Trade when Charm is on cooldown. Build two stacks with Mortal Steel, then dash in and knock her up.
Hit Ahri with Spirit Cleave when you close in; it hurts her and gives you a shield against her poke.
Look for Fate Sealed when Spirit Rush is down; she has little way to escape, so you can kill her.
Use Soul Unbound to dash through terrain and dodge Charm. Attack her while in spirit form to store damage for the return.
Poke Akali with Mortal Steel to build stacks. The third cast dashes and knocks her up, so use it to start a trade.
Fight her when her energy is low, because she can't trade freely with Five Point Strike then.
Use Spirit Cleave when you trade. It gives you a shield and hits her hard.
Back off at level 6 when she has Perfect Execution up and your health is low.
Use Fate Sealed on Akali when she tries to run. It stuns her and pulls her to you.
Walk up to Akshan with two Mortal Steel stacks when you can. The dash knocks him up and closes the gap.
Sidestep Avengerang, since it comes back after it flies out. Staying out of its line saves you from being hit twice.
Use Spirit Cleave when you trade. The shield helps you win the exchange, and it grows when you hit a champion.
Look for Fate Sealed once Akshan swings in. It stuns him and pulls him to you, and it hits several targets.
Akshan may use Going Rogue to hide near walls and brush. Don't chase him blindly, because he can ambush you.
Step out of the line of Flash Frost and don't walk into the stun at the end of its range. It's your biggest danger early.
Build up two stacks of Mortal Steel on minions, then dash through Anivia with the third for a knock up.
Use Spirit Cleave to get a shield while you trade. Hit Anivia with it to gain more shield than from minions alone.
Use Soul Unbound to dodge a Flash Frost. Hit Anivia while it's active so your return deals extra damage.
Her Crystallize wall blocks your dash, so check where it is before you go in.
Fate Sealed can catch Anivia from far away. Kill her egg too, because she comes back with full health if it survives.
Dodge Annie's stun by staying away when her Pyromania counter is full; she can stun with any of her spells.
Use Mortal Steel to build two stacks on minions or Annie, then dash in with the knock up to get on top of her.
Use Spirit Cleave when you trade with her; the shield cuts down the damage she deals back.
Use Soul Unbound to step in and hit Annie, then recall to your body to take your damage back to safety.
Stay away from Tibbers after he is summoned; his burn hurts anyone nearby.
Dodge Breath of Light by stepping to the side and closing in; Aurelion Sol wants to hit you from range.
Use Soul Unbound to move in and snap back out safely; the return dash can't be stopped by crowd control.
Get two hits of Mortal Steel in before you commit; the third knocks up and dashes you onto him.
Use Spirit Cleave when you enter his range for the shield; it also deals extra damage based on his max Health.
Wait out his Astral Flight; once he lands he is easier to catch with Fate Sealed.
Walk up and use Mortal Steel on minions to build stacks. The third cast dashes and knocks Aurora up, so save it for when she has used The Weirding.
Dodge sideways when Aurora fires Twofold Hex. Its bolt is blocked by units in its path, so stand behind minions.
Use Spirit Cleave when you trade, so you get a shield that makes up for her magic damage.
Aurora can vanish with Across the Veil, so don't chase her blindly. Finish her before she hops, or back off.
Use Fate Sealed to catch her after she hops away. It stuns her and pulls her to you, even when she is far off.
Stay out of her Between Worlds ring. Crossing its edge slows you, and she can jump across it.
Dodge Azir's Sand Soldiers and don't stand in them. Dash in after he spends them on Conquering Sands.
Use Spirit Cleave on Azir to get a shield before you trade into his soldiers.
Enter Soul Unbound to close in on Azir. Hit him while in spirit form so you deal more damage when it ends.
Don't use Fate Sealed into Azir's Emperor's Divide wall. It blocks your path, so wait until it is gone.
Build two Mortal Steel stacks on minions or Azir, then dash through him. The knock up gives you time to hit him.
Sidestep Sear; Brand needs to land a spell to start his combo, and a missed Sear leaves him without the stun.
Keep a minion between you and Brand; Sear stops at the first unit it hits.
Use Spirit Cleave to get a shield when you trade, since it also hits minions and hurts him.
Walk out of Pillar of Flame once you see it start; it lands after a delay.
Build Mortal Steel stacks on minions, then dash through Brand with the knock up when he has used his spells.
Use Soul Unbound to dodge his spells and trade in spirit form, then snap back to your body.
Move away from your minions and allies when Brand casts Pyroclasm; the first missile is slow and bounces are weaker with fewer targets.
Keep Mortal Steel stacked and short-cooldown poke on Briar early; she has no natural health regeneration.
Use Spirit Cleave when Briar leaps in; the shield soaks her burst and the damage scales with her health.
Stay out of Head Rush range when it is ready; the stun makes you take a full combo.
Don't fight with your back near a wall when Briar can charge Chilling Scream; it knocks you into the wall for a big stun.
Use Soul Unbound to dash away from Briar when she frenzies at you. Your body stays behind, and her damage is repeated on return.
Dodge Noxious Blast by walking out of the circle, which lands after a short delay. Don't stand still to last-hit.
Don't rely on Soul Unbound to get away from Miasma. Being grounded stops movement abilities.
Look away from Cassiopeia when she casts Petrifying Gaze, so you are slowed instead of stunned.
Build two stacks of Mortal Steel on minions, then dash onto Cassiopeia. She is weakest when you are on top of her.
Use Spirit Cleave to shield yourself while trading, because Cassiopeia's poison damage adds up quickly.
Sidestep Crescent Strike; being marked lets Diana dash onto you again and again.
Use Spirit Cleave to get a shield when Diana's Pale Cascade orbs are around you, or wait until the orbs and shield run out before you fight.
Build two stacks of Mortal Steel before you trade, then knock Diana up when she dashes in.
Stay away from other enemies when Diana hits level 6; Moonfall pulls you in and slows you.
Use Soul Unbound to hit and escape; its stored damage lands when you snap back.
Dodge Timewinder's first throw; its return hits again, so leave the slowing field quickly.
Watch for Ekko's afterimage from Parallel Convergence and don't stand where it lands, since it stuns when he steps in.
Go in with Fate Sealed when Ekko's Chronobreak is down; he is much weaker then.
Use Spirit Cleave when you trade; the shield softens Ekko's burst.
Close the gap with Soul Unbound to dodge Ezreal's Mystic Shot, then fight him up close. Ezreal is fragile, so take the fight to him.
Keep minions between you and Ezreal so his Mystic Shot hits them and not you. Mortal Steel the minions to stack up your knock up.
Use Spirit Cleave to shield yourself while you take his poke; it works best when it hits a champion.
Hold Fate Sealed for when Ezreal uses Arcane Shift. It pulls him in, even if he blinked away.
Wait for Fizz to spend Playful before you go in; while it's down he can't easily escape your Fate Sealed or a knock up.
Build two hits of Mortal Steel on Fizz or minions, then dash in with the third to knock him up.
Use Spirit Cleave when Fizz comes close; it hurts more against high Health and gives you a shield.
Stay away from Fizz when his trident is glowing; Seastone Trident makes his next hits hurt more.
Sidestep the Chum the Waters fish, since it sticks to the first champion it touches; keep close to minions and move sideways.
Stay out of Winds of War range. Sidestep it, because the tornado where the blasts meet hurts a lot.
Don't walk up while Galio charges Shield of Durand. Wait for the taunt to end before you attack him.
Keep Soul Unbound ready as an escape. Its dash can get you out of Justice Punch range.
Galio's Hero's Entrance can be interrupted before he jumps. Hit him with Mortal Steel's knock up in that window.
Walk at Hwei in a wavy line and stay out of a straight path; Devastating Fire and Severing Bolt both need him to guess where you will be.
Rush Hwei right after he casts a Torment spell. He is vulnerable then, and Fate Sealed can pull him to you.
Dodge Grim Visage by keeping a minion between you and Hwei. It stops at the first enemy it hits and fears and slows them.
Use Spirit Cleave to get a shield before you walk into his poke. It grows when it hits a champion.
Hold Soul Unbound for the all-in. Hit him while in spirit form, then snap back to deal the stored damage.
Stay away from minion waves when Irelia is near; she dashes through them to reach you.
Use Soul Unbound to trade, then snap back before Irelia can respond with Bladesurge.
Mortal Steel knocks Irelia up on the third cast; save it for when she dashes in so she cannot act.
Do not spend Fate Sealed on a charging Defiant Dance; wait until she releases it.
Step out of the line between Flawless Duet's blades as soon as you see the first one land.
Use Spirit Cleave when Irelia dashes onto you; the shield helps you survive her trade.
Walk up and poke Kassadin with Mortal Steel early. He is weak before level 6, so push your lead.
Hold Spirit Cleave until Kassadin walks into range. He cannot easily dodge it, and it gives you a shield.
Be careful of Force Pulse. Once he is slowed you cannot get away, so stay out of its cone.
Fate Sealed can catch Kassadin when he lands from Riftwalk. Wait for him to use it, then strike.
Stay out of Katarina's range when Bouncing Blade is ready; step in to trade only after she has used it.
Hit Katarina with Mortal Steel twice, so the third cast dashes in and knocks her up. Use it when she has no Shunpo to escape.
Use Spirit Cleave when she jumps in; the shield softens her burst, and she is hurt more if she is low on health.
Save Fate Sealed for when Katarina starts Death Lotus. It stuns her and cuts off her channel.
Walk away from Daggers on the ground, because Katarina's pickup slash hits everyone nearby.
Stay out of LeBlanc's range and dodge Ethereal Chains; if you are tethered and she is close, move out of the chain's reach to avoid the root.
Use Mortal Steel on minions to build stacks, then dash onto LeBlanc with the third cast to knock her up.
Hit LeBlanc right after she uses Distortion. Fight her at that point and stun her with Fate Sealed to stop her return.
Use Spirit Cleave to shield yourself when she pokes you, especially if it hits her too.
Use Soul Unbound to chase or to trade, since the stored damage comes back when you return to your body.
When LeBlanc drops low, a fake copy appears with her. Hit the one that stays near you instead of chasing the clone.
Walk up behind minions so Ice Shard hits them first; it only slows the first target it hits.
Engage while Ring of Frost is on cooldown; if it lands, you are rooted and take heavy damage.
Use Mortal Steel on minions to build stacks, then dash in with the knock up when Lissandra's Ring of Frost is down.
Hit Lissandra when she uses Glacial Path with a stun or knock up before she recasts; she cannot blink away.
Use Spirit Cleave when you trade with her; the shield helps you absorb her damage.
Stay behind minions so Light Binding hits them first. It only roots the first two enemies it hits.
Close the gap with Mortal Steel's second-stack dash, but only once Light Binding is on cooldown.
Use Spirit Cleave when you reach Lux. The shield helps you survive her follow-up.
Step out of Lucent Singularity early. Its slow lasts a moment after you leave and the detonation slows you again.
Fate Sealed pulls Lux toward you, so use it at level 6 when she is out of position.
When Lux fires Final Spark, move sideways out of the line. A red warning beam shows where it will go.
Wait for Malzahar to use Call of the Void before you go in. Then he has little to stop you.
Stay out of Malzahar's Call of the Void line. Walk sideways, because it lands after a short delay.
Build two stacks of Mortal Steel on minions or Malzahar, then dash in with the third.
Don't go in while Malzahar's Void Shift is up. Hit him first with a cheap poke, then fight.
Use Spirit Cleave on Malzahar and the Voidlings when you trade. The shield helps you survive.
Stay away from minions carrying Malefic Visions. When they die it spreads to you.
Walk out of Solar Snare's line before it lands; if it connects you are rooted and Mel can follow up. Close in on her only when it is on cooldown.
Hold Mortal Steel's knock-up and Fate Sealed until Mel has spent Rebuttal, because her nova destroys enemy projectiles that touch it.
Back off for a moment when your health gets low. Mel's Overwhelm stacks can execute you, and they fall off if she stops hitting you.
Use Spirit Cleave to trade into Mel and take the shield it gives. Hitting her with it makes the shield larger.
Use Soul Unbound to dash in, hit Mel, then snap back to your body. The damage you dealt is repeated on her, and you can leave her reach.
Hit Naafiri with Mortal Steel twice, then use the third cast to dash in and knock her up.
Use Spirit Cleave when you trade; it hits her packmates too, and you get a bigger shield when it hits her.
Attack her while in spirit form with Soul Unbound, then snap back to repeat part of the damage you dealt. Do it as you trade, not before.
Watch for her to vanish with The Call of the Pack; she cannot be targeted briefly, so hold your damage until she reappears.
Use Fate Sealed to catch her after she commits to a dash. It stuns her, so finish the fight right away.
Dodge Orianna's Command: Attack by stepping sideways; it is narrow, so you can often avoid it.
Look at where the Ball is. Orianna's abilities only affect the area around it, so stay out of range when you can.
Respect Orianna at level 6; Command: Shockwave pulls you in and stuns you, so don't stand next to the Ball.
Trade with Spirit Cleave when she is close; it hurts and gives you a shield.
Use Soul Unbound to dodge her spells and hit her, then return to your body.
Count your Mortal Steel hits so the third one lands as a dash and knocks Qiyana up when she steps in.
Use Spirit Cleave when Qiyana dashes in; the shield helps you survive her burst.
Fight away from walls and river; Supreme Display of Talent stuns you there.
Respect her root when she holds the river element; step out of the line of Elemental Wrath.
Use Soul Unbound to trade, hitting her before the recast. It returns you to safety and adds damage.
Close the gap quickly with Mortal Steel. Two hits make the third dash and knock up, so land the first two on a minion or on Ryze.
Walk out of the line of Overload and stay off minions in its path. Ryze hits much harder once he has put Flux on you.
Use Spirit Cleave when you reach Ryze. The shield grows when it hits a champion, so it helps you survive his combo.
Ryze cannot easily escape you once you are on him. Use Fate Sealed to stun him and pull him in at level 6.
Stun or knock up Ryze while Realm Warp is channeling and the portal cancels.
Stay out of Chain Lash range and sidestep it. Taking the slow and the blast when you step up to the wave gives Sylas a free trade.
Keep Mortal Steel stacks ready for when Sylas uses Abduct. The knock-up dash finishes him off if he is close.
Use Spirit Cleave for the shield when you trade with Sylas. The shield absorbs some of his burst.
Do not go all-in on Sylas when his health looks low. Kingslayer heals him back up.
Fight Sylas right after he spends Hijack on another champion. He can't take your Fate Sealed for a good while after.
Dodge Syndra's Dark Sphere, and do not walk onto a sphere lying on the ground. She can push it with Scatter the Weak to stun you.
Go in right after Syndra uses Scatter the Weak. Its cooldown is long, so she can't easily knock you away.
Use Soul Unbound to move faster and close the gap. Attack her while in spirit form and the stored damage hits when you snap back.
Use Spirit Cleave to get a shield when you trade, so Syndra's poke does less to you.
Hit Syndra twice with Mortal Steel to dash in and knock her up. That works well when she has used her spells.
Do not dash through Taliyah's stones from Unraveled Earth. If you do they go off and stun you.
Step out of the marked area when Taliyah aims Seismic Shove at you. If you are thrown into her stones, you take extra damage and get stunned.
Sidestep Threaded Volley, because the rocks fly in a fixed line. Use Spirit Cleave's shield when you have to walk through her poke.
Use Soul Unbound to close the gap on Taliyah and hit her while in spirit form. It adds damage when you snap back.
Don't stand in a line at Talon's range; Rake hits twice and slows you. Step out of its cone.
Land two Mortal Steel hits, then dash in with the third to knock Talon up and start your trade.
Use Spirit Cleave as Talon dives in; the shield soaks some of his burst.
Use Soul Unbound in a trade to gain move speed and add extra damage when you snap back.
Look for a fight when Talon has used Shadow Assault. Without it he struggles to escape, so Fate Sealed can finish him.
Walk at an angle when Twisted Fate throws Wild Cards, and stay out of his line of fire. Early hits cost you a lot of health.
Watch Twisted Fate's Pick a Card. When the Gold Card is locked in, stay out of his attack range, because the stun gets you killed.
Hit him with Mortal Steel twice to get the knock-up dash, then follow with Spirit Cleave to gain a shield for the trade.
Look out for Destiny. When Twisted Fate uses it, you have been marked, so go back and don't wander in the side lanes.
Use Fate Sealed when you can catch Twisted Fate away from his team. He cannot escape before it lands.
Watch for Event Horizon. Walk out of the cage rather than through its edge, because only the edge stuns you.
Sidestep Dark Matter once its warning appears. It lands after a delay, so keep moving when Veigar aims at you.
Use Fate Sealed to reach Veigar when he is close to you. It stuns him and pulls him in, and it can end the fight quickly.
Veigar is fragile, so once you get close, trade with Mortal Steel and Spirit Cleave. Spirit Cleave also gives you a shield.
Stay out of Baleful Strike's line and keep minions between you and Veigar. It only hits the first two enemies.
Keep your Health high when Veigar has Primordial Burst, because it hits harder as you get lower.
Don't dash at Vex when her empowered ability is ready; Doom interrupts dashes and fears you.
Your dashes mark you for her bonus damage, so use Mortal Steel and Soul Unbound to close in only when she has little to follow up with.
Sidestep Mistral Bolt; it is a long wave and Yone can dodge it by moving out of the line.
Use Spirit Cleave to get a shield when trading, since her Personal Space and Looming Darkness are what you must trade through.
Use Fate Sealed to stun and pull Vex into reach once her Personal Space is on cooldown.
Close the gap with Mortal Steel on minions to build stacks. Then dash in on the third cast and knock Viktor up before he can set up.
Step out of Gravity Field quickly. Staying inside gets you slowed and then stunned.
Use Soul Unbound to dodge Hextech Ray and get close. Hit him while in spirit form, and the stored damage lands when you snap back.
Fight when Siphon Power is on cooldown. His shield and empowered attack are what make his trades strong.
Use Spirit Cleave when you trade with him. It hits hard and shields you.
Don't walk into Vladimir's range early; Transfusion hurts and heals him, so trade only when his cooldown is down.
Make Vladimir spend Sanguine Pool early in a fight, then go in; he can't be hit while pooled and costs him health.
Hit Vladimir with your Spirit Cleave to get a shield before you trade, then follow with Mortal Steel.
Hit Vladimir with attacks while Soul Unbound is up so the stored damage lands when you snap back.
Kill Vladimir before Hemoplague bursts, or step out of it; his heal grows for each champion hit.
Walk at Xerath and close the gap. Mortal Steel needs you close, and he is weak in melee.
Dodge Shocking Orb by keeping a minion in front of you or by moving sideways. It is a thin line shot, and a long stun is dangerous.
Use Spirit Cleave to shield yourself while you trade. You gain more shield if it hits a champion.
Use Soul Unbound to dodge when Xerath casts Arcanopulse. Its beam needs a long charge and he is slowed while charging.
Fate Sealed stuns and pulls Xerath into you even from far away. Use it at level 6 to finish him when he is out of position.
Step out of the circle when you see Eye of Destruction land. Its center slows you far more than the edge.
Poke with Mortal Steel and keep stacks up. At two stacks the third cast dashes and knocks Xin Zhao up, which starts your trade.
Use Spirit Cleave when Xin Zhao fights you. It deals damage based on his max health and gives you a shield.
Stay out of Audacious Charge range once Xin Zhao has marked you. It reaches farther against Challenged enemies, and his Three Talon Strike follows it.
Move out of the thrust line of Wind Becomes Lightning. It slows you and marks you as Challenged.
Hold the Mortal Steel whirlwind until Wind Wall is on cooldown, since the wall blocks it. Poke with the short thrust meanwhile.
Spirit Cleave goes through Wind Wall, so use it to trade with Yasuo when he thinks the wall protects him.
Don't knock Yasuo up near his allies' range. Any airborne champion lets him use Last Breath and teleport onto you.
Attack Yasuo once his shield has run out, because the shield from Way of the Wanderer is brief. Then trade.
Use Soul Unbound to trade, then recast it to snap back to safety. Yasuo's Steel Tempest is narrow, so sidestep it.
Walk out of line from Razor Shuriken, since it keeps flying through minions and hits you. Stay out of line with Zed's Shadow too.
Fight Zed right after he uses Living Shadow, when his slow and mobility depend on that Shadow.
Land Mortal Steel twice on Zed or his minions, then dash through him to knock him up when he is committed.
Use Spirit Cleave to shield yourself when Zed is about to trade with you; it gives more shield when it hits a champion.
When Zed puts Death Mark on you, back away from the fight. Trade less so the mark stores less damage, and don't chase him.
Dodge Sleepy Trouble Bubble by sidestepping it. It stops at the first enemy it hits, so a minion in front of you can block it.
Use Soul Unbound to close the gap on Zoe. The extra move speed helps you reach her, and your hits are stored as damage.
Zoe stays in place after Portal Jump, so hit her with Fate Sealed or Mortal Steel then.
